resources.memory_enforcement: Windows Job Object hard process committed-memory limit; sampled private and working-set telemetry

margin_rule: Report nominal gates separately; a numerically separated component pass additionally requires max(base,refined matched TV)+1e-5<=0.000740 for every history. The reserve is a frozen numerical guard, not a rigorous error certificate.

forecast.rule: signed delta22 forecast = delta20*(21/23)^2, outcome by outcome; no subtraction from measured probabilities
forecast.acceptance: For each history, half_L1(delta22/a22^2-delta20/a20^2)/half_L1(delta20/a20^2)<=0.10 for both solves; all seven must pass. If denominator=0 require numerator<=1e-10. Diagnostic separate from finite gates.

candidate: Recompute N22 geometry weights with the unmodified B2 quadratic rule; keep Hamiltonian, boundary, Gaussian, preparation and timing list unchanged.
stop_rule: One standard N22 point and one refined N22 point. Archive a miss, exception or resource failure; no automatic N24, retry, fitting, allowance transfer or massive run.
massive_rule: No massive run under any N22-01 verdict. N22 cannot clear B2's withheld N20 transfer. A future massive study requires its own declared resolution and dictionary.
scope: Finite massless experiment under the adopted operator dictionary, not an asymptotic theorem, ground-state error certificate, interacting-continuum result or distinctive GRUT law.
